verdict.rationale: The Messages API documents token-incremental streaming via server-sent events with `"stream": true`, and every client SDK has built-in streaming support. Fine-grained tool streaming also delivers tool inputs as they are generated. Latency is addressed through documented levers: fast mode (up to 2.5x output speed), the effort parameter (trading intelligence for latency), and prompt caching (reduced processing time). Missing for 10: concrete latency figures (time-to-first-token or sub-second response guarantees), a documented description of streaming latency behavior itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming speed.
